blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Background music that matches the mood of a text has been shown to make readers feel more immersed and improve their reading experience, motivating recommender systems that pair books with mood-matched music. In this direction, we present Sentiment Aware Generative Adversarial Network for Cross Domain Recommendation (SAGA-CDR), a two-phase cross-domain recommendation framework that personalizes music suggestions and emotionally aligns them with the book being read. In the first phase, transformer-based sentiment embeddings are constructed from user reviews and mapped across domains via a Conditional Generative Adversarial Network, whose mask-conditioned generator handles missing sentiment components and injects stochasticity for richer preference transfer. A compact rating neural network then fuses sentiment-specific interaction scores with a collaborative filtering prior to predict music ratings. In the second phase, large language models classify each book into a valence–arousal emotional quadrant, and candidate tracks are filtered to match that quadrant. Experiments on both the English Amazon and Chinese Douban datasets show that SAGA-CDR achieves the best rating prediction accuracy on Amazon (RMSE 0.98 0.98 ) and the lowest RMSE on Douban ( 0.91 0.91 ), with ranking performance competitive with the strongest sentiment-aware baseline, even in cross-lingual settings.
blocks.zh: 与文本的情绪相匹配的背景音乐已被显示,让读者感到更沉浸并改善其阅读体验,激励推荐人系统将书籍与情绪相匹配的音乐相配. 为此,我们介绍了跨域建议感知基因网络(SAGA-CDR),这是一个分两阶段的跨域建议框架,将音乐建议个性化,在情感上与正在阅读的书相配合. 在第一阶段,基于变压器的情绪嵌入是通过用户审查构建的,并通过一个有条件的基因变压器网络绘制出跨域图,其带有口罩的生成器处理缺失的情绪元件并注入更丰富的偏好转移的花样. 紧凑的评级神经网络然后将情绪特定互动分数与协作过滤相接后再预测音乐收视率. 在第二阶段,大型语言模型将每本书分类为一出华丽的情感象限,对候选音轨进行过滤以与象限相匹配. 英国亚马逊和中国杜邦数据集的实验显示,SAGA-CDR在亚马逊取得了最佳的评级预测精度(RMSE 0.98 0.98)和杜邦上的最低RMSE(0.91 0.91),其排名性能与最强的感知基线相竞争,即使在跨语言环境下也是如此.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Recommender systems (RSs) operating within a single domain cannot leverage preferences expressed across different content types. Cross-domain recommendation (CDR) addresses this shortcoming by transferring knowledge from a source domain, where user activity is abundant, to a target domain where data are sparse. Most CDR methods rely on structural signals such as shared latent factors or user-item interaction patterns, ignoring the rich emotional information embedded in user-generated text.
blocks.zh: 在一个单一域内运作的推荐系统无法利用不同内容类型表达的偏好。 跨域建议通过将知识从用户活动丰富的源域转移到数据稀少的目标域来解决这一缺陷。 大多数CDR方法依赖于共享潜在因素或用户-项目交互模式等结构信号,而忽略了用户生成的文本所嵌入的丰富的情感信息.

blocks.en: In the books & music case, emotional alignment is particularly well-motivated. Experimental evidence shows that emotionally congruent background music significantly enhances reading immersion and perceived text quality [ 1 ] . A RS for this scenario must therefore satisfy two simultaneous objectives: (i) match individual user taste and (ii) align with the emotional tone of the book being read. In order to address these issues, we propose Sentiment Aware Generative Adversarial Network for Cross Domain Recommendation (SAGA-CDR), a two-phase recommendation pipeline, whose main contributions are: • A formulation of emotion-guided book-to-music recommendation as a two-phase task, combining cross-domain preference transfer with valence–arousal congruence between the book and the recommended track. • A cross-domain mapping in which the deterministic bridge used by prior sentiment-aware CDR methods is replaced by a conditional GAN with a presence mask over sentiment partitions and noise injection, addressing missing partitions and one-to-many transfer mechanisms. • An affective filtering stage in which LLMs assign books to VA quadrants, with the choice of LLM informed by a human study on cases where the models disagree. • An empirical evaluation on two public benchmarks, including cross-lingual transfer from sparse English data to dense Chinese data, with post-hoc SHAP and ICE analysis.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Structural and Mapping Approaches
blocks.zh: II-A 结构和绘图方法

blocks.en: Traditional CDR methods often focus on structural signals, learning a bridge function between independently trained embedding spaces. EMCDR [ 2 ] trains separate Matrix Factorization (MF) models per domain and fits a shared multi-layered perceptron (MLP) to translate source user embeddings to the target space, providing a cold-start profile for unseen users. PTUPCDR [ 3 ] extends this approach with a meta-network that generates a personalised bridge function for each user, conditioned on a characteristic embedding derived from their transferable interests in the source-domain interaction history. More recently, HEAD [ 4 ] leverages hyperbolic representations to model hierarchical user–item interactions while preserving power-law structures across domains. Meanwhile, CFAA [ 5 ] aligns BERT-based cross-domain user and item embeddings through Optimal Transport and graph-based attribution matching to mitigate domain discrepancy. However, these methods operate purely on interaction data and metadata, overlooking the rich affective signals embedded in review text. While some models, like RC-DFM [ 6 ] , inject raw review text into Stacked Denoising Autoencoders to bridge latent spaces, sentiment is not extracted explicitly.
blocks.zh: 传统的CDR方法往往注重结构信号,在独立训练的嵌入空间之间学习桥梁功能. EMCDR [2] 列车每个域的分出矩阵因子化(MF)模型,并适合一个共享多层受体(MLP)来翻译源用户嵌入到目标空间,为未见用户提供冷启动剖面. PTUPCDR [3] 将这一方法扩展为元网络,为每个用户生成个性化桥接功能,以源域互动史中其可转让权益所产生的特征嵌入为条件. 最近,HEAD[4]利用双曲表达方式来模拟等级用户-项目互动,同时维护跨领域的权力法结构。 同时,CABA [5]通过"优化运输"和"以图表为基础的归属比对"对基于BERT的跨域用户和项目嵌入进行校正,以缓解域差异. 然而,这些方法完全依靠交互数据和元数据运作,忽略了审查文本中蕴含的丰富的感应信号. 一些模型,如RC-DFM[6],将原始审查文本注入了Stacked Denoising Autoencoders,以弥合潜在空间,但情绪并没有被明确提取出.

blocks.en: II-B Sentiment-Aware Approaches
blocks.zh: II-B 感知办法

blocks.en: To enrich representations beyond interaction patterns, a second line of work incorporates sentiment or emotion extracted from user reviews. CDR-SAFM [ 7 ] partitions reviews into three polarity classes using a rating-based heuristic, applies Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) to each class, and trains independent MLPs to map sentiment topic vectors across domains. STN-CDRS [ 8 ] addresses data sparsity by converting unrated text reviews into pseudo-ratings using sentiment analysis from a recurrent neural network. CRAS [ 9 ] uses VADER to discard negative reviews, retain only positive and neutral reviews for topic extraction, and train an improved CycleGAN to translate user preference matrices between domains. UTAM [ 10 ] combines TextBlob and BERT for aspect-level sentiment, clustering users thematically and matching source-domain clusters to target-domain counterparts. Moving to richer affect representations, AAPAM [ 11 ] extracts seven-dimensional emotion profiles via a Tweet Affective Classifier, identifying cross-domain user pairs by affective cosine similarity. ECDR [ 12 ] builds six-dimensional emotion profiles derived from Parrott’s hierarchical model, applying symmetric KL-divergence to identify emotionally similar target-domain users for collaborative filtering (CF). More recently, an affect-centric stance has been adopted by certain approaches [ 13 ] , by mapping music and visual art to a shared VA space, matching items by sentiment proximity using contrastive multimodal learning on audio, visual, and LLM-generated text features. Beyond sentiment, personality-aware RSs employ user traits to mitigate the cold start efect [ 14 ] , while responsible RSs prioritize the users’ well-being and explainability over engagement [ 15 ] . SAGA-CDR shares both aims, using review sentiment instead of personality and explaining its predictions via SHAP/ICE and LLM justifications (Table I ).
blocks.zh: 为了丰富互动模式以外的表述,第二行的工作包括从用户审查中提取的情绪或情感。 CDR-SAFM [7] 分区使用基于分级的heuristic进行三极分级审查,将Latett Drichlet Digition(LDA)应用于每个分级,并训练独立的MLP来绘制跨域的情绪主题向量. STN-CDRS [8] 通过使用从经常性神经网络的情绪分析,将无评级文本评论转换为伪评分,解决了数据垃圾. CRAS [9] 使用VADER来丢弃负面评论,只保留正中性评论来取出主题,并训练改进后CycleGAN来翻译域间的用户偏好矩阵. UTAM [10] 结合了TextBlob和BERT,用于侧面级别情绪,将用户按主题分组,并将源域集群匹配到目标域对应方. 走向更丰富的影响表示,AAPAM [11]通过Tweet Affective Classiner来取取出七维情感剖面,通过相感同位素相似性来识别跨域用户对. ECDR [12] 构建出从Parrot的分级模型中衍生出来的六维情感剖面,应用对称的KL-潜水来识别情感相近的目标域用户进行协作过滤(CF). 最近,某些方法[13]采取了以影响为中心的立场,将音乐和视觉艺术映射到一个共享的VA空间,利用在音频、视觉和LLM生成的文本特征上的对比式多模式学习,通过情绪相近来匹配项目。 除了情绪之外,个性意识的RSs利用用户的特质来缓解寒冷的起伏效应[14],而负责任的RSs则优先考虑用户的福利和可解释性,而不是参与[15]. SAGA-CDR赞同这两个目标,使用审查情绪而不是个性,并通过SHAP/ICE和LLM的理由解释其预测(表一)。

blocks.en: II-C SAGA-CDR
blocks.zh: II-C SAGA-CDR 软件

blocks.en: The literature on sentiment-aware CDR demonstrates a clear technological evolution from early lexicon-based tools and topic modeling, to deterministic MLPs, and finally to modern transformer-based architectures and multimodal learning. By utilizing a RoBERTa model fine-tuned on 124M tweets, we produce contextual 768-dimensional per-review embeddings that capture linguistic nuances missed by static LDA topics. Our main technical contribution is the replacement of deterministic bridges with a mask-conditioned stochastic Conditional GAN. Its explicit noise injection models the inherent one-to-many uncertainty in cross-domain preference transfer, while mask conditioning robustly handles users with missing sentiment partitions—practical data-quality issues often ignored by prior methods.
blocks.zh: 关于情绪意识的CDR的文献显示,从早期的以词汇为基础的工具和主题建模,到确定MLP,最后到现代变压器为基础的建筑和多模式学习,都有明显的技术演变. 通过使用在124M的微博上微调的RoBERTa模型,我们制作了背景768维的每回审查嵌入,捕捉静态LDA主题所忽略的语言细微差别. 我们的主要技术贡献是用一个有口罩的有花样的GAN来取而代之。 其明确的噪声注入模型是跨域偏好转移中固有的一对多的不确定性,而口罩调节则强力地处理情绪隔断缺失的用户——实际数据质量问题往往被先前的方法所忽略.

blocks.en: III-D Emotion-Driven Recommendation
blocks.zh: 三-D 情感驱动建议

blocks.en: In emotion-driven recommendation (2 nd phase), the recommendation process is enhanced through emotional alignment between books and music. Book summaries are analyzed using LLMs to determine their dominant emotional tone within a VA framework. Music tracks are also categorized according to their emotional characteristics. The system then filters predicted recommendations by selecting music items that share the same emotional quadrant as books the user has enjoyed, thereby producing recommendations that are not only personalized but also emotionally consistent with the user’s reading experience. The two phases are decoupled deliberately: quadrant classification runs offline (16.73 s per summary vs. 34.0 ms per forward pass), keeping online scoring lightweight and letting the filter’s strictness change without retraining the mapping. The quadrant is shared by all readers of a book; personalization comes from Phase 1, as the filter acts on each user’s own music candidate pool.
blocks.zh: 在情感驱动的推荐(第2个阶段)中,通过书和音乐之间的情感相配合来增强推荐过程. 书籍摘要使用LLMS进行分析,以确定其在VA框架内的主要情感语调. 音乐曲目也根据其情感特征分类. 系统然后通过选择与用户所享受的书籍具有相同情感四分道位的音乐项目来筛选建议,从而产生不仅个性化而且情感上符合用户阅读经验的建议. 这两个阶段是故意脱钩的:四分法分类线下线(每分法16.73 s,每分法34.0 ms),保持在线评分轻量级,使过滤器的严格性变化而不对绘图进行再培训。 四角形由一本书的所有读者共享;个性化来自第一阶段,因为过滤器在每一个用户自己的音乐候选集合中起作用.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 summarizes the full pipeline. In Phase 1 (lines 1–16), Douban reviews are first translated to English, every review is encoded into a sentiment label and embedding, and these are mean-pooled into per-sentiment user and item representations. The CGAN is then trained to map source-domain user embeddings to the target domain, after which the rating module is trained on the quantile-normalized features. In Phase 2 (lines 17–25), each book summary is assigned a VA quadrant by Qwen3 offline; at recommendation time, the generator produces the user’s music-domain profile, the rating module scores each candidate track, and only tracks with r ^ ≥ 4 \hat{r}\geq 4 that match the book’s quadrant are kept, ranked by predicted rating.

blocks.en: IV-A 2 Douban (Books → \to Music)
blocks.zh: IV-A 2 Douban (书籍 ~\去音乐)

blocks.en: A Chinese-language benchmark from the Douban social network [ 18 ] , with ≈ 101.7 {\approx}\,101.7 music reviews per user—roughly 30 × \times denser than Amazon. Evaluated via 5-fold cross-validation (1249/139/348 train/val/test users per fold) on seed = 42 =42 .

blocks.en: For both datasets, we retain only users with reviews in both domains, since CDR requires learning and assessing a user-level transfer function from source preferences to target behavior. Cold-start items unseen during training ( I cold = I val/test ∖ I train I_{\text{cold}}=I_{\text{val/test}}\setminus I_{\text{train}} ) are handled via TF-IDF category matching in the Amazon dataset. For each unseen category c ∉ C train c\notin C_{\text{train}} , the most similar training category c ~ \tilde{c} is identified via cosine similarity over TF-IDF vectors. Each cold-start item’s category is replaced with c ~ \tilde{c} , and its embeddings are imputed with the mean of training items in that mapped category. For Douban (no category metadata), cold-start items receive the global mean training embedding. Test users’ target-domain interactions serve only as ground truth: at inference the model sees exclusively the user’s source-domain (book) profile, making the evaluation a strict target-domain cold-start setting.
blocks.zh: 对于这两个数据集,我们只保留了两个领域都有评论的用户,因为CDR需要学习和评估用户级的传输功能,从源首选项到目标行为. 训练期间未见的冷起项目(I cold = I val/test = ∖ I train I train ),通过亚马逊数据集的TF-IDF类匹配处理. 对于每个不见的类别 c C 列车 c\notin C\\text{train},最相近的训练类别 c ~\tilde{c}通过同位素相似度确定在TF-IDF向量上. 每个冷启动项的类别被 c ~\ tilde{c} 所取代, 其嵌入值被算入该绘图类别的训练项的平均值 。 对于Douban(无分类元数据),冷启动项目接受全球平均培训嵌入。 测试用户的目标域互动只是作为地上真理:推断模型只看到用户的源域(book)配置,使评价成为严格的目标域冷起设定.

blocks.en: IV-A 3 Baselines
blocks.zh: 基线

blocks.en: We compare SAGA-CDR against three CDR baselines, selected specifically to evaluate performance with and without textual signals. The first two are EMCDR [ 2 ] and PTUPCDR [ 3 ] . Both use MF, with the former mapping embeddings through a deterministic MLP and the latter on a per-user meta-network. They fall under the structural and mapping category of systems (Section II-A ) and act as rating-only control groups. We intentionally include these text-agnostic models to assess the performance of methods that operate purely on ratings.
blocks.zh: 我们比较SAGA-CDR与三个CDR基线,这些基线是专门用来评估有文字信号和没有文字信号的性能. 前两个是EMCDR[2]和PTUPCDR[3]. 两者都使用MF,前者通过定型的MLP嵌入了前作的映射,而后者则在每用户元网络上嵌入了后作. 它们属于系统的结构和绘图类别(第二-A节),并充当只评级的控制组。 我们有意列入这些文本不可知模型,以评估纯粹根据评级运作的方法的性能。

blocks.en: To ensure a fair comparison against models that do utilize rich review text, our third baseline is CDR-SAFM [ 7 ] , which employs LDA topic features stratified by sentiment polarity, with three MLP regressors for cross-domain mapping. It is a sentiment-aware approach (Section II-B ), as it implements explicit, personalized sentiment-feature mapping.
blocks.zh: 为确保与使用丰富审查文本的模型进行公平比较,我们的第三个基线是CDR-SAFM[7],它利用LDA专题特征按情绪极性进行分级,有三个MLP递归器进行跨域绘图。 这是一种感知方式(第二至B节),

blocks.en: We chose these specific baselines, because more recent text-based methods use sentiment mainly as an intermediate step, to impute missing ratings as pseudo-ratings [ 8 ] , filter reviews [ 9 ] , or form user clusters [ 10 ] , rather than as the representation mapped across domains. Furthermore, state-of-the-art affect models (e.g., [ 13 ] ) require multi-modal inputs, such as raw audio or visual features. Evaluating them in our setting would require modifying their formulation, so an observed gap could reflect our adaptation rather than the method itself.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了这些具体的基线,因为较近期的以文字为基础的方法主要使用情绪作为中间步骤,将缺失的评分归类为伪评分[8],过滤评分[9],或者形成用户群[10],而不是绘制跨域的表示. 此外,最先进的影响模型(如[13])需要多种模式的投入,如原始音频或视觉特征。 在我们的环境下对其进行评估将需要修改其表述,因此所观察到的差距可以反映我们的适应,而不是方法本身。

blocks.en: For EMCDR and PTUPCDR, we employ the official implementations [ 3 ] , while CDR-SAFM is re-implemented from [ 7 ] ; all systems share the same train/validation/test user splits.
blocks.zh: 对于EMCDR和PTUPCDR,我们采用正式执行[3],而CDR-SAFM则从[7]重新执行;所有系统共用相同的列车/验证/测试用户拆分.

blocks.en: IV-B Hyper-parameters
blocks.zh: 四-B 超参数

blocks.en: Hyperparameters were selected using Copeland’s method [ 20 ] across three random seeds ( 0 , 42 0,42 and 2026 2026 ). Four CGAN configurations (Section III-B ) were evaluated over ( l ​ r G lr_{G} , l ​ r D lr_{D} , λ \lambda ): ( 2 × 10 − 4 , 2 × 10 − 4 , 1.0 ) (2\times 10^{-4},2\times 10^{-4},1.0) , ( 2 × 10 − 4 , 2 × 10 − 4 , 5.0 ) (2\times 10^{-4},2\times 10^{-4},5.0) , ( 4 × 10 − 4 , 1 × 10 − 4 , 5.0 ) (4\times 10^{-4},1\times 10^{-4},5.0) and ( 4 × 10 − 4 , 1 × 10 − 4 , 10.0 ) (4\times 10^{-4},1\times 10^{-4},10.0) , with the third being selected. Selection was based on validation-set cosine similarity between generated and target embeddings. The asymmetric learning rates—with a higher rate for the generator—allow for more aggressive generator updates while keeping discriminator training stable. λ = 5.0 \lambda=5.0 outperformed both extremes, indicating that neither suppressing the adversarial signal ( λ ≥ 10 \lambda\geq 10 ) nor deprioritizing reconstruction ( λ = 1.0 \lambda=1.0 ) is beneficial.

CGAN training used a batch size of 512 and a 200-epoch schedule with early stopping (patience 30), which terminated at approximately epoch 145. The training curves are displayed in Fig. 2 . The discriminator loss decreases steadily but never approaches zero, so the discriminator does not saturate and the generator continues to receive informative gradients throughout training. Correspondingly, the generator’s loss rises and then stabilizes. The validation cosine similarity between generated and target embeddings rises steadily before plateauing at about 0.64. Training does not diverge: the only irregularity is a single spike in the discriminator loss near epoch 141, which is absorbed within one epoch. The downstream rating network, trained on the generated embeddings with a 1000-epoch budget, also trains smoothly. Its training and validation losses (Fig. 2 , bottom right) decrease together, with the validation loss flattening at about 0.86 by roughly epoch 600 and not rising afterwards, showing no sign of overfitting.

blocks.en: IV-C 1 Music dataset construction.
blocks.zh: IV-C 1 音乐数据集构建.

blocks.en: The MERGE Audio Dataset [ 21 ] provides VA-annotated tracks, which are further discretised into four quadrants: (i) Q1 (energetic/positive: Pop, R&B), (ii) Q2 (energetic/negative: Metal, Punk), (iii) Q3 (calm/negative: Soul, Blues), (iv) Q4 (calm/positive: Jazz, Bossa Nova) [ 22 ] . To connect it to the Amazon ecosystem, both datasets are normalized (lowercased, punctuation stripped) and joined on the resulting title field to produce a candidate metadata table M meta M_{\text{meta}} . To guard against spurious title matches across different artists, a strict artist-name validation filter is applied: a match is retained only if the MERGE artist name appears in at least one Amazon text field (product description, review text, store name, or title). Of the 3554 MERGE tracks, 1372 match an Amazon title and 365 survive artist validation, forming M final M_{\text{final}} , which maps each song’s audio file and emotional quadrant to its Amazon ASIN.
blocks.zh: MERGE音频数据集 [21] 提供了VA-附加说明的音轨,这些音轨被进一步分解为四个四位数:(一)Q1(正值/正值:Pop,R&B),(二)Q2(正值/负值:Metal,Punk),(三)Q3(正值/负值:Soul, Blues),(四)Q4(正值/正值:Jazz, Bossa Nova)[22]. 为了将其与亚马逊生态系统相连接,两个数据集都实现了常态化(下接,被剥去)并加入由此而来的标题字段,生成候选元数据表M meta M_{\text{meta}}. 为了防止不同艺术家之间虚假的标题匹配,采用了严格的艺术家名称验证过滤器:只有当MERGE艺术家名称出现在至少一个亚马逊文本域(产品描述,审查文本,存储名,或标题)时,才会保留匹配. 在3554个MERGE音轨中,1372个匹配了亚马逊标题和365个幸存的艺术家验证,组成了M final MQQText{finalQ}},将每首歌曲的音频文件与情感四角映射到其亚马逊ASIN.

blocks.en: The CMU Book Summary Dataset [ 23 ] provides Wikipedia plot summaries. blocks.en: IV-C 3 LLM book classification

blocks.en: Three open-source LLMs (LLaMA 3.1 8B [ 24 ] , Qwen3 8B [ 25 ] , and DeepSeek-R1 8B [ 26 ] ) are run locally via Ollama (temperature = = 0, fixed seed = 42 =42 ) to classify each book into a VA quadrant. Each model receives the same structured prompt (Fig. 3 ): it is framed as a musical curator for literature asked to select the quadrant representing the book’s dominant, persistent mood as if the music will accompany the full reading experience. The prompt defines each quadrant with VA coordinates, a qualitative description, and representative genres, then requires a structured Q{1--4}: <reasoning> output. This structured output enables reliable automated parsing, while the natural-language justification lets annotators audit the models’ reasoning in disputed cases and could be surfaced to end-users as an explanation.
blocks.zh: 有3个开源LLM(LLaMA 3.1 8B [24],Qwen3 8B [25],和DeepSeek-R1 8B [26])通过Ollama(温度==0,固定种子=42=42)在当地运行,将每本书分入一VA象限. 每个模型都得到同样的结构化的快取(图3):它被设定为一个音乐的文献管理员,被要求选择代表该书主导性的持续情绪的四角,仿佛音乐会伴随完整的阅读经验. 提示符用 VA 坐标、 定性描述和代表性流派定义每个象限, 然后需要结构化的 QQ1- 4}: < reasoning> 输出 。 这种结构化的产出可以进行可靠的自动化解析,而自然语言的理由则允许注释者对模型在有争议案件中的推理进行审计,并可以向最终用户说明。

blocks.en: Majority vote [ 27 ] resolves cases where at least two models agree; of the 129 books, 53 received unanimous assignments, 70 were resolved by a 2-to-1 majority, and 6 were fully disputed (all three models disagreeing) and forwarded to human evaluation. These 129 are the subset of B final B_{\text{final}} rated above 4 stars by evaluation users, since a soundtrack is only meaningful for a book the reader actually enjoyed. A form was generated from the LLM output and for each disputed book, annotators were shown the title, an author-curated one-paragraph summary sourced from Wikipedia and Goodreads (to avoid LLM-influenced wording), and the reasoning provided by each disagreeing model for its proposed quadrant. Reviewers were instructed to select the quadrant best representing the book’s dominant, persistent mood—mirroring the framing used in the LLM prompt.
blocks.zh: 多数投票[27]解决了至少两个模式同意的案件;在129本书中,53本获得一致分配,70本以2比1的多数解决,6本被完全争议(三个模式都不同意)并被转交人评价. 这129是B Final BQQText{finalQQQ被评价用户评为4星以上的子集,因为一个音轨只对读者实际享受的一出书有意义. 从 LLM 输出中生成了一个表格,对于每本有争议的书,都会显示标题,一个作者校准的一段摘要来源于维基百科和Goodreads(以避免 LLM 影响的措辞),以及每个作者为它提议的四象限提供的有不同意见的模型的推理. 已指示审查人员选择最能代表该书主导性、持续情绪的象限 -- -- 模仿LLM提示中使用的框架。

blocks.en: IV-C 4 Final recommendation

blocks.en: For a book rated more than 4 4 stars in the Amazon dataset, Qwen3 assigns its quadrant. The recommended track candidate pool ( r ^ ≥ 4.0 \hat{r}\geq 4.0 ) is filtered to the matching quadrant and ranked by predicted score. Table I shows the reading soundtrack recommendations produced by the full pipeline. Since a recommendation must satisfy both criteria, the trade-off appears as coverage rather than quality: at least one candidate survives for 46 of 139 (user, book) pairs (33.1%), and the mean predicted rating among surviving pairs is statistically unchanged (4.591 before and after filtering, paired t-test p = 0.85), since the filter removes candidates outright rather than reordering them. Coverage is bounded by the catalogue (365 tracks, 129 books), not the method.

blocks.en: V Results
blocks.zh: 五 结果

blocks.en: Table II shows that SAGA-CDR achieves the best rating prediction performance for the Amazon dataset by a substantial and statistically significant margin, on both prediction accuracy metrics. The RMSE of 0.9806 and MAE of 0.6097 represent a 12.5% relative RMSE improvement over CDR-SAFM, the closest sentiment-aware competitor.
blocks.zh: 表二显示,SAGA-CDR在亚马逊数据集的分级预测性能上,在两个预测准确度指标上都以实质性和统计性能显著的比值达到最佳. RMSE为0.9806和MAE为0.6097,这代表了RMSE相对于CDR-SAFM的12.5%的相对改善,CDR-SAFM是感情意识最强的竞争对手.

blocks.en: Table III draws an equally clear picture for the rank accuracy metrics on the Amazon dataset. At k = 1 k{=}1 —the strictest test of whether the single best recommendation is immediately relevant—SAGA-CDR significantly outperforms both EMCDR & PTUPCDR. This advantage is sustained and is also statistically significant across every cut-off and every precision-oriented metric (MAP, NDCG, MRR) for these two baselines. It is important to note that EMCDR and PTUPCDR still have high ranking metrics in absolute terms (above 88% at k = 1 k{=}1 ). Combined with their rating errors (Table II ), however, it can be concluded that MF-based methods fail to perform as well in sparse regimes ( ≈ 3.5 {\approx}\,3.5 reviews per user) as review-based methods, even when they order items reasonably.
blocks.zh: 表三对亚马逊数据集的分级精确度指标作了同样清晰的描绘. 在k = 1 k{=}1 时——最严格地检验单一最佳建议是否立即相关——SAGA-CDR明显优于EMCDR和PTUPCDR. 这一优势是持续的,而且从统计学上来说,在这两个基线的每个断点和每个精准的衡量标准(MAP、NDCG、MRR)中都具有重大意义。 需要注意的是,ECMCDR和PTUPCDR在绝对值上仍然有高排名的衡量标准(超过88%,在k=1 k{=}1). 然而,加上其评分错误(表二),可以得出结论,基于MF的方法不能在稀有的制度(每个用户大约3.5个,3.5个审查)中作为基于审查的方法,即使在它们合理订购项目时也是如此。

blocks.en: Against CDR-SAFM, SAGA-CDR ties on all ranking metrics. In our setting, however, rating accuracy carries more weight. Phase 2 forms each user’s candidate pool with an absolute threshold ( r ^ ≥ 4.0 \hat{r}\geq 4.0 ), so the specific tracks to be recommended depend on predictions being correct on the rating scale, a step that ranking metrics computed on Phase 1 do not capture. In rating prediction, SAGA-CDR clearly leads (RMSE = 0.98 vs. 1.12), making it the only method to pair the best prediction accuracy with tied-best ranking. For HR@ k k (where k > 1 k>1 ), all methods are statistically tied at every cut-off, suggesting that the main distinction is not whether a relevant item appears in the top- k k list, but how highly relevant items are ranked within that list.
blocks.zh: 反对CDR-SAFM,SAGA-CDR在所有排名指标上的联系. 然而,在我们的设定中,评级准确性具有更大的分量。 第2阶段以绝对阈值(r ^ 4.0\hat{r}\geq 4.0)组成每个用户的候选集合,因此所推荐的具体音轨取决于对评级尺度的预测是否正确,这个步骤在第1阶段计算出的分数不能捕捉到. 在评级预测中,SAGA-CDR明显领先(RMSE = 0.98 vs 1.12),使其成为将最佳预测精度与捆绑-最佳排名相配的唯一方法. 对于 HR@ k (其中k > 1 k > 1),所有方法在统计上在每次断接时都捆绑在一起,说明主要的区别不是相关项目是否出现在最高- k k 列表中,而是该列表中高度相关项目的排名.

blocks.en: Prior to analyzing the Douban results, an asymmetry in the setup should be noted: SAGA-CDR operates under a more demanding transfer regime, with the CGAN having been pre-trained on sparse English Amazon data - since the CGAN requires a larger paired cross-domain signal than Douban alone provides - and only the rating module having been fine-tuned on Douban. Once learned, the mapping transfers effectively even across language and density shifts (Table IV ).
blocks.zh: 在分析杜邦结果之前,应该注意设置中的不对称:SAGA-CDR在要求更高的传输制度下运行,CGAN在稀少的英国亚马逊数据上经过了预先的训练——因为CGAN需要比杜邦单独提供的更大的对接的跨域信号——只有评级模块在杜邦上进行了微调. 一旦了解情况,即使跨语言和密度变化,制图也有效转移(表四)。

blocks.zh: 表格 四:杜邦结果(5倍CV平均值). 粗体:好;下划线:次等.

blocks.en: The competing baselines (CDR-SAFM, EMCDR, PTUPCDR) are evaluated both with and without Amazon pre-training, denoted in Table IV as pre-tr. and no-pre. , respectively, allowing a direct assessment of how much each baseline benefits from cross-dataset transfer versus training on Douban alone. SAGA-CDR is evaluated in three configurations, reflecting different strategies for handling the Chinese review text: (i) notrans (no translation; Chinese-only RoBERTa), (ii) multi (no translation; multilingual XLM-RoBERTa), and (iii) trans. (reviews machine-translated to English via Helsinki-NLP [ 28 ] , then encoded with the same English-pretrained sentiment model used on the Amazon dataset). These models perform the initial sentiment recognition and user-review embedding generation, after which the resulting representations are passed to the remaining stages of SAGA-CDR.
blocks.zh: 对相互竞争的基线(CDR-SAFM、EMCDR、PTUPCDR)的评价既包括亚马逊前期培训,也包括非亚马逊前期培训,在表四中分别称其为前期培训和前期培训,从而可以直接评估每个基线从跨数据集的转让中获取的惠益,而仅靠Douban培训即可。 SAGA-CDR以三种配置评价,反映了处理中文评论文本的不同策略:(一) notrans (没有翻译;只使用中文的RoBERTa),(二)多(没有翻译;多语言的XLM-RoBERTa),(三) trans. (通过Helsinki-NLP[28]审查机器翻译为英语,然后用亚马逊数据集上使用的相同的英语预操作情绪模型编码). 这些模型进行初始情感识别并进行用户审查嵌入生成,之后产生的表达被传递到SAGA-CDR的剩余阶段.

blocks.en: Paired one-sided t t -tests across the 5 CV folds, with Holm–Bonferroni correction per baseline over the 18 reported metrics, confirm SAGA-CDR’s advantage over EMCDR and PTUPCDR on both prediction-accuracy metrics ( p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 for all variants) and on MAP and NDCG at nearly every cut-off. Against CDR-SAFM, SAGA-CDR has lower RMSE and matches it on every ranking metric; CDR-SAFM leads only on MAE (p = 0.008) and only under cross-lingual transfer: on Amazon, SAGA-CDR leads on MAE as well (p = 0.0145).
blocks.zh: Paired 单侧 t - t测试跨越了5个CV折叠体,Holm - Bonferroni在18个已报告的度量基准上进行了校正,证实了SAGA-CDR在预测准确度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值 与CDR-SAFM相比,SAGA-CDR的RMSE较低,在每个排名度量标准上都与之相匹配;CDR-SAFM只领先于MAE(p = 0.008),并且只在跨语言传输下:在亚马逊,SAGA-CDR领先于MAE(p = 0.0145).

blocks.en: V- 1 Prediction Accuracy
blocks.zh: V- 1 预测精确度

blocks.en: Despite operating under the most demanding experimental conditions - cross-lingual transfer from a sparse English corpus to a dense Chinese one - SAGA-CDR attains the lowest RMSE ( 0.9057 0.9057 ) of all methods evaluated on Douban, outperforming even baselines trained from scratch directly on the target data, while maintaining a competitive MAE of 0.7284 0.7284 . The fact that SAGA-CDR, a model carrying cross-domain mappings from English Amazon reviews, matches or even exceeds target-trained competitors, constitutes the strongest evidence so far that the learned sentiment representations encode preference structure surviving both domain and language shift at the same time.
blocks.zh: SAGA-CDR在对Douban公司的所有评估方法中取得了最低的RMSE(0.9057. 0.9057),在目标数据上直接从头开始培训的基线都比实际水平高,同时保持了0.7284. 0.7284的竞争力。 SAGA-CDR(英语:SAGA-CDR)是英国亚马逊评论中搭载跨域绘图的模型,匹配甚至超过目标训练的竞争对手,这是迄今为止最有力的证据,说明所学的情感表现编码偏好结构同时存活于域和语言转变.

blocks.en: V- 2 Ranking Performance
blocks.zh: V - 2级成绩

blocks.en: SAGA-CDR leads all methods on precision-sensitive ranking metrics at k ∈ { 1 , 3 , 5 } k\in\{1,3,5\} , taking the top position across MAP, NDCG, and MRR at these cut-offs, while holding the second-best position on HR@ 5 5 and remaining competitive at k = 10 k{=}10 for most of the ranking metrics. Attaining this under cross-lingual transfer, where the closest competitor is trained directly on Douban, reflects the quality of the learned cross-domain user representations and their ability to distinguish highly relevant items from the rest of the candidate pool.
blocks.zh: SAGA-CDR带领所有方法在 k {{ 1, 3, 5} k\\in 1, 3, 5} 的精密敏感分级衡量标准上, 在这些分级中占据了整个MAP, NDCG, 和 MRR的顶级位置,同时在 HR@ 5 5 5 上占据了第二好的位置,并且对于大多数分级衡量标准仍然保持以 k = 10 k\ 10. 在跨语言转让下实现这一点,最接近的竞争者直接在杜班上接受培训,这反映了所学跨域用户表现的质量,以及他们与候选人才库其他部分高度相关的项目区分的能力。

blocks.en: V- 3 Effect of Language Strategy
blocks.zh: 五. 语文战略的效果

blocks.en: The three variants reveal a clear hierarchy: translating reviews to English prior to encoding ( SAGA-CDR ) is the strongest overall configuration, followed by multilingual encoding ( multi ), with the monolingual Chinese model ( notrans ) last, particularly on prediction accuracy. This ordering reflects representational alignment: the full training stack is anchored in English pretraining, so keeping review text in English eliminates cross-lingual mismatch. The multilingual model is a practical alternative when translation is unavailable, at a cost to prediction accuracy.
blocks.zh: 三种变体揭示出明确的分级:在编码前将评论翻译为英语(SAGA-CDR)是最强的整体配置,其次是多语种编码(多语种),最后是单一语言的中文模型(notrans),特别是在预测准确性方面. 这个命令反映了代表式的校正:完整的训练堆被固定在英语预训中,因此保留英语的审校文本消除了交叉语言的不匹配. 在无法翻译时,多语种模式是一种实用的可选办法,其代价是预测准确性。

blocks.en: Ablation
blocks.zh: 读取

blocks.en: To isolate the contribution of each CGAN component, we retrain SAGA-CDR on Amazon with one component removed at a time, keeping the sentiment representations, rating module, hyper-parameters, seeds and splits unchanged, and test each variant against the full model with the same one-sided paired t-tests as in the Amazon experiments. Removing the adversarial term has the largest effect on rating prediction, raising RMSE from 0.981 to 1.002 and MAE from 0.610 to 0.640 (MAE: p = 0.013): without it, the generator is trained only to reconstruct target embeddings and loses the discriminator’s signal about which source–target pairs are plausible. Removing noise injection, the presence mask or the reconstruction loss slightly lowers RMSE but raises MAE (0.621–0.636); neither change is statistically significant. On ranking metrics, all four variants exhibit worse performance, significantly below the full model on MAP, NDCG and MRR at k = 1 k{=}1 and k = 10 k{=}10 . Table V showcases these prediction and ranking metrics of the ablation study. Every variant still outperforms CDR-SAFM on RMSE and MAE, but only the full model matches it on ranking metrics. Therefore, all components of the full model play a meaningful role in achieving the overall system performance.

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we presented SAGA-CDR, a two-phase emotionally guided CDR framework for the books-to-music setting. The 1 st phase combines contextual transformer-based sentiment representations with a stochastic, mask-conditioned CGAN cross-domain mapping and a bias-aware rating prediction module. The 2 nd phase uses an LLM to classify books into VA emotional quadrants and filters personalized music candidates to match the book’s VA quadrant. Experiments demonstrated that SAGA-CDR excels on prediction accuracy and remains competitive on ranking metrics, while also proving to be highly robust under complex cross-lingual transfer conditions. Also, SHAP and ICE analyses confirm interpretable, domain-consistent behavior. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first framework to address personal taste and emotional alignment together in a books-to-music CDR setting.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们介绍了SAGA-CDR,这是一个两相情感引导的CDR框架,用于书到音乐的设定. 1st相结合了以上下文变压器为主的情绪表达,并配以有分色,有口罩的CGAN跨域映射和有偏感的评级预测模块. 第2个阶段使用LLM将书籍分类为VA情感四重奏并过滤个性化音乐候选者,以与该书的VA四重奏相匹配. 实验表明,SAGA-CDR在预测准确性方面表现优异,在排名指标方面仍然具有竞争力,同时证明在复杂的跨语言转移条件下也非常有力。 另外,SHAP和ICE分析也证实了可解释,域相容的行为. 据我们所知,这是第一个框架, 解决个人的品味 和情感的配合 在书对音乐的CDR设置。

blocks.en: Several promising directions for future work emerge from this study. Firstly, transitioning from discrete emotional quadrants to a continuous VA space could capture fine-grained affective nuances, potentially allowing for chapter-level granularity that produces a dynamic soundtrack evolving alongside the narrative arc. On the audio front, incorporating pre-trained music understanding models to extract embeddings directly from raw waveforms would expand coverage beyond metadata-linked catalogues and provide richer affective estimates. Furthermore, although CGAN training converged stably here, diffusion models, which avoid adversarial optimization altogether [ 31 ] , could provide a more stable mapping conditioned on source-domain embeddings. For future work, we will also conduct live user studies with a larger population to measure emotional congruence during real reading sessions; the present work establishes only quadrant agreement, since the subjectivity of affective judgments makes perceived congruence measurable only through a controlled study. Finally, we will adapt and evaluate more recent sentiment-aware CDR methods under our formulation.
